_note: Aliveness probe set (#6652). Three layers on one map: FELT (a person reports feeling alive, or dead inside), WORLD (a text says nature, matter or the heavens are alive, or that they are not), MADE (a text says a place, building, image or crafted thing is alive, or lifeless; Christopher Alexander's sense). Every layer carries its opposite as separate dimensions (polarity: -1) so the map can show where deadness is described as well as where life is. Probes are sentences in period-plausible voice, not topic labels: retrieval matches passages, and a label like 'vitalism' retrieves modern prose about vitalism.

layers.label: Felt aliveness
layers.gloss: a person reports feeling alive, or dead inside

layers.label: The world as alive
layers.gloss: nature, matter or the heavens are said to live, or not

layers.label: Aliveness in made things
layers.gloss: a place, building, image or crafted thing is said to be alive, or lifeless

dimensions.label: Quickening
probes: I felt the life rush back into my limbs as warmth returns to a frozen hand
a new vigour ran through my whole body and I was strong again
my heart leapt within me and every sense awoke at once
it was as though a fire of life had been kindled in my breast

dimensions.label: The world made vivid
probes: every leaf and every stone seemed new to me, as if I saw them for the first time
the colours of the fields shone with a freshness I had never seen before
all creation appeared to me clothed in a new and living beauty
the morning was so bright and so alive that I could have wept for joy

dimensions.label: Rebirth
probes: I was as one born again, and the old man in me was dead
from that day I lived as if I had risen from the grave
I woke from a long sleep of the soul into true life
it seemed I had passed from death into life

dimensions.label: Exuberant gladness
probes: my body could not contain my gladness and I leapt and sang
such joy filled me that I danced like a child
my blood sang in my veins and I could not keep still for delight
I laughed aloud for the sheer joy of being alive

dimensions.label: Full wakefulness
probes: I was wholly awake and present, and nothing stood between me and the moment
my mind was clear and keen and every breath was felt
I seemed for the first time truly awake in my own body
I attended to each thing as it came and was entirely there

dimensions.label: Strength returning
probes: after the fever left me my strength came back day by day and I could walk again
the sick man rose from his bed and felt himself whole and lively
colour returned to my face and appetite to my body
I recovered my spirits and my old liveliness returned

dimensions.label: Acedia and deadness of heart
probes: my heart was dead within me and nothing could move it
I took no pleasure in anything, neither prayer nor food nor company
a dryness and weariness of soul came upon me so that I loathed all things
I sat idle in my cell and the hours would not pass

dimensions.label: Numbness, living death
probes: I walked among men as one already dead
I felt nothing, neither grief nor joy, as though I were made of stone
the world seemed grey and far away and I was not in it
I lived but was not alive

dimensions.label: Heaviness and torpor
probes: a heaviness lay on all my limbs and I could not rouse myself
my spirits were dull and sluggish and my blood cold
melancholy weighed me down so that I could barely lift my head
I was sunk in a lethargy from which nothing could wake me

dimensions.label: The world soul
probes: the whole world is one living creature, having a soul and a mind
a single soul pervades the universe and animates every part of it
the world is not a dead thing but lives and breathes as a great animal
there is nothing in the universe that is not alive

dimensions.label: Vital breath (pneuma, spiritus, prana, qi)
probes: a subtle breath runs through all things and gives them life
the vital spirit is carried in the blood and quickens every member
when the breath departs the body, life departs with it
the life force flows through the channels of the body and of heaven and earth alike

dimensions.label: Living metals and stones
probes: metals grow in the womb of the earth as a child grows in its mother
the stone has a soul and a seed, and it must die before it can live again
gold is ripened in the mountains by the heat of the sun over long ages
the mineral lives, feeds and multiplies according to its nature

dimensions.label: Ensouled heavens
probes: the stars are living beings, moved by their own souls and intelligences
the heavens are animated and their motion is a kind of life
the sun is the heart of the world and pours life into all things
each sphere has its own spirit which turns it

dimensions.label: The earth as a body
probes: the earth has veins as a body has veins, and the waters are its blood
the tides are the breathing of the earth
the mountains are the bones of the earth and the rivers its arteries
the earth is our mother, and she feeds and nourishes all living things

dimensions.label: The soul of plants
probes: the plant has a soul that nourishes it, makes it grow, and brings forth seed
trees feel and suffer when they are cut
every herb has its own virtue and spirit, which it draws from the stars
the seed holds within it the whole living form of the tree

dimensions.label: Sympathy and attraction
probes: the lodestone loves the iron and draws it to itself
things of like nature are drawn to one another by a secret friendship
the vine hates the cabbage and turns away from it
all things in nature are bound together by sympathy and antipathy

dimensions.label: Matter as dead mechanism
probes: matter of itself is inert and moves only when another body pushes it
the world is a machine, like a clock wound up by its maker
animals are automata, without feeling, moved by springs and weights
there is no soul in stones or plants; they move only by the laws of motion

dimensions.label: A place that feels alive
probes: there was something in that place which drew me back to it again and again
the town was full of life, and to walk its streets made the heart glad
the place seemed to breathe, and everything in it belonged there
I have never been in a place so living and so peaceful

dimensions.label: Spirit of the place
probes: every grove and spring has its own spirit that dwells there
the old people said the place had a guardian and must be greeted on entering
the spirit of the place was offended and the crops failed
this ground is holy, for a power lives in it

dimensions.label: The building as a body
probes: the temple must be built in the proportions of a well-formed man
a building, like a living body, must have all its members in due measure
the house is a little world, as man is a little world
the church is the body of Christ and its stones are living stones

dimensions.label: Wholeness of parts
probes: each part answers to every other, so that nothing can be added or taken away without harm
the work grows from within like a plant, not put together from without
all its parts agree in such harmony that it seems one living thing
the beauty of the whole arises from the fitting of each part to the next

dimensions.label: The cultivated garden
probes: the garden flourished under his care and was full of birds and fragrance
the orchard must be tended as one tends a child
in the garden every plant was set where it would thrive best
the gardener works with nature, not against her, and so the garden lives

dimensions.label: The maker's spirit in the work
probes: the craftsman put his whole soul into the work, and so the work lives
the painter gave such life to the figure that it seemed about to speak
a thing made with love has a life that a thing made for gain does not
the statue was so lifelike that one waited for it to breathe

dimensions.label: The ensouled image
probes: the priests drew down the spirits into the statues so that the images lived
after the rite of consecration the god dwells in the image
the image wept, and moved its eyes, and spoke
by this art the figure receives life and power from the heavens

dimensions.label: Lifeless work
probes: the work was correct in every rule and yet cold and dead
the building had no grace, a mere heap of stones without spirit
it was made by rote, without love, and it shows
the copy has the form of the original but none of its life
